user.title: Add THE WALL
user.description: Enter the device ID from the device page of the website. THE WALL then shows a code on the panel, which you type in on the next page.

data_description.server: Only change this if you run your own server.

zeroconf_confirm.title: THE WALL found
zeroconf_confirm.description:
Add {name} ({uid}) to Home Assistant? After you submit, the panel shows a code for five minutes.

Server: {server}

pair.title: Code on the panel
pair.description: Type in the code that {name} shows on the panel. It has {length} characters, upper or lower case does not matter.

restart.title: New code
restart.description: The code on the panel no longer works. Submit, and {name} shows a new one.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair {name} again
reauth_confirm.description: The server no longer accepts this Home Assistant, for example because the link was removed on the website. Submit, and {name} shows a new code on the panel.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the server. Check the address and the connection.
error.device_offline: The device has not been online for two minutes, so it cannot show a code. Check power and WiFi.
error.invalid_device_id: That is not a device ID. It looks like wall-7f3a91.
error.invalid_url: That is not a web address.
error.pairing_expired: The code has expired. It is valid for five minutes.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.too_many_attempts: Five wrong codes. This code no longer works.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Details are in the log.
error.unknown_device: The server has no device with this ID.

abort.already_configured: This device is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: This device is already being set up.
abort.invalid_discovery_info: The device announced itself without a usable ID or server.

api_error.message: The THE WALL server answered with an error: {message}

cannot_connect.message: Cannot reach the THE WALL server: {error}

device_not_found.message: Device {device_id} does not belong to THE WALL.

entry_not_found.message: Config entry {entry_id} does not belong to THE WALL.

invalid_duration.message: A timer runs from 1 to {max} seconds.

invalid_token.message: The THE WALL server no longer accepts this Home Assistant. Pair the device again.

no_entries.message: THE WALL is not set up yet.

no_update.message: There is no newer firmware for this device.

rate_limited.message: Too many requests to the THE WALL server. Try again in a moment.

target_required.message: Several THE WALL devices are set up. Pick one.

too_many_timers.message: Five timers are already running. Cancel one first.

cancel_timer.name: Cancel timer
cancel_timer.description: Cancels one timer, or all timers when no ID is given.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Instead of the device, the config entry of the THE WALL.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The THE WALL with the timer. Not needed with only one.

id.name: Timer ID
id.description: The ID from the response of start_timer or the timer_id attribute of the timer sensor. Empty cancels all timers.

start_timer.name: Start timer
start_timer.description: Starts a timer on the panel. At most five run at the same time.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Instead of the device, the config entry of the THE WALL.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The THE WALL that shows the timer. Not needed with only one.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the timer runs, from one second to 24 hours.

label.name: Label
label.description: Shown next to the timer, at most 12 characters.
